questions.question_text: Which type of memory holds information for a very short duration, typically less than 30 seconds?
questions.explanation: Short-term memory stores small amounts of information for a brief period before it is either encoded into long-term memory or lost.

questions.question_text: Which type of memory keeps information for a very short duration, usually under 30 seconds?
questions.explanation: Short-term memory acts as a temporary store for information that lasts only for a short time unless rehearsed.

questions.question_text: Which type of memory holds information for less than 30 seconds?
questions.explanation: Short-term memory stores small amounts of information for brief durations, typically under 30 seconds without rehearsal.

questions.question_text: What is the 'nature vs. nurture' debate about?
options: Whether people prefer nature or city life
The impact of genetic inheritance vs. environmental factors on behavior
questions.explanation: This debate explores the relative importance of biological factors (nature) versus upbringing (nurture) in shaping personality and behavior.
